name: text-line-by-line-reveal
title: Line-by-Line Reveal
description: Ba dòng chữ lần lượt trồi lên 28 px, mỗi dòng trong mặt nạ riêng, dòng sau bắt đầu khi dòng trước vừa đọc được.

moworks.author: takayu

options.lines: the line elements (each gets its own mask)
options.exitY: em they leave upward (1.3, 0.25 s ease-in cubic)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio line-by-line, written here): 3 lines (26 px type), each in its own overflow-hidden mask (140×32 px). Line i: translateY +28 px → 0, 0.55 s easeOutCubic, start 0.3 + 0.24·i s (no fade in the canvas demo). Loop exit: line i slides up 34 px out of its mask, 2.2 + 0.06·i s, 0.25 s inCubic; loop 2.8 s. DOM version (2.2 s loop): same 28 px plus opacity 0 → 1, 682 ms each, 242 ms apart, ease cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1). Params: duration: mỗi dòng (0.55 s) · stagger: độ lệch giữa các dòng (0.24 s) · y: quãng trồi (28 px) · ease (easeOutCubic).
moworks.titleVi: Từng dòng trồi lên khỏi mặt nạ
